en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing the courtyard and arched colonnades of a Spanish-style mission complex with tile roofs and a small bell wall topped by a cross. Shrubs and paths fill the foreground. Red caption text along the bottom identifies it as Mission San Juan Capistrano in Orange County, California, and red vertical text along the sides notes it was printed in Germany and published in Los Angeles by M. Rieder. A red number 5731 is printed in the lower right corner.
